name: Highlighted line hook
what: Small bold words on a dark ground come up one by one, a short top line first and then a longer line word by word; then a colour bar sweeps behind the long line while its words turn from light to dark.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f8-f20 (00:00:00:08-00:00:00:20) the first word rises ~58 px, growing from half size as its letters close up and fading in; f20-f44 (00:00:00:20-00:00:01:14) the second word does the same, slowly, beside it; f41-f89 (00:00:01:11-00:00:02:29) the words of the second line come up one by one (f41, f49, f54, f59, f64, f72), each quick, the last one slow; f64-f105 (00:00:02:04-00:00:03:15) a bar sweeps behind the second line, left to right, an S-curve; f77-f90 (00:00:02:17-00:00:03:00) the second line's words turn from light to dark; then it holds to f119 (00:00:03:29)

tracks.name: top line
tracks.what: two words come up in turn: the first quick, the second slow

tracks.name: second line
tracks.what: six words come up one after another, each rising, growing and fading in

tracks.name: bar
tracks.what: the colour bar sweeps behind the second line, left to right
tracks.easing: S-curve (slow start, fast middle, slow end)

tracks.name: words darken
tracks.what: the second line's words turn from light to dark so they read on the bar
